page.layout: One page of text: upper running text full width; below it a centred title block in large type. A faint table grid show-through in the lower half is not printed text. A digitiser's link at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: cessione vera oriuntur, sed mutato ordine præpo-stere descendunt, Sub ipso vero mundi polo, totius anni spacium in diem uertitur naturalem, cuius dies artificialis semestri, nox itidem semestri com-pletur. Æquator enim in locum Horizontis subi-ens zodiacum in duo dispescit hemicyclia, Septen-trionale semper apparens, Austrinum vero occul-tatum.
main_text.head: TABVLA MAXIMO-rum dierum artificialium ad singulas eleuationes poli, habitantium à circulo arctico, usque ad po-lum arcticum.

page.notes: Top line fragmentary at the start of the page (cont. from previous page). The title is set in large spaced type; the first word "TABVLA" and the ending "MAXIMO-" continue as "rum" on the next line. Text on the right edge is faint; ligature "ct" in "arctico" and "arcticum" follows the printed spelling "arctico", "arcticum". Possible printing forms retained as printed.
